scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently applied for a housing loan and I was wondering about the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved, denied, or if it's still pending? Also, I'd like to know what the interest rate is if it was approved.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The interest rate for your loan is 7.375%.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. I'm glad to hear that my application was approved. Could you also tell me the total costs of this loan and whether there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The total costs associated with your loan are not included in the record. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has not been sold to another institution. You were approved for a conventional first lien loan.

dialogue.user: Got it. Could you also tell me what my debt-to-income ratio is and whether it had any impact on my application?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is between 30% and 36%. The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot confirm if this ratio had any impact on your application.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I have all the details I need now. <Satisfied> The agent was helpful and provided clear answers to my questions, which I appreciate.
